response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_count FROM grouped), shares AS (SELECT g.ID, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS FLOAT) / t.total_count as share FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN totals t), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value FROM shares), kept_groups AS (SELECT s.ID, s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_share_value FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share_value) SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_record_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share_value) as avg_excess FROM kept_groups
